metadata.Description: Using JavaScript and the Pico 8 color palette, this collection generates unique pixel art images. Each image is uniquely derived from a seed, which is generated from the inscription ID. The resulting pixel art showcases a variety of characters and designs, each defined by a distinct combination of colors and patterns.

metadata.title: Genetic Collection Root
metadata.description: Genetic Launchpad follows the ORD provenance spec: the creator uses their Protogen to inscribe Collection Root as the Protogen's child. When collectors use Genetic Launchpad to mint collection members, their resulting inscriptions are intrinsically linked to the parent, the Collection Root. These links connect the asset to Root and Root to Protogen, providing a transparent on-chain provenance record for the newly created asset.

metadata.Title: RAINBOW BAMBOO
metadata.Description: Digital Art on Bitcoin blockchain coded to color shift with every new viewing. Each individual Bitcoin inscribed collectible will randomly generate a new color scheme variation while maintaining the familiar structure design
metadata.Artist Notes: I intentionally created this collection to resonate with the emotions of both Familiarity & Change to offer an artistic, therapeutic, & symbolistic approach to stimulate & exercise positive thought patterns associated with the mental healing benefits of finding comfort in the familiar, while consciously letting go to better appreciate the beauty of change that is today.

metadata.No Brainers:
We are hooked into the 24-7 digital casino. Silicon and bone, wires, blood, and nodes. Half human hybrids. Cyborg aliens. In the ultimate PVP arena. Holding to zero, like sand through skeletal fingers.
My best plays happen without thought, only impulse. My best work happens in a rush of madness, a divine message from the subconscious hive-mind, broadcast deep into my ‘soul’. Awake!
Scribble it down, traveler. The tamagotchi caveman grunts. He’s dying a slow death, but it's feeding time.
I am my own dog, tethered on chain, Yapping into the void, post physical, the ultimate isolation, FINALLY FREE! “Welcome to the future,” they say, “Gatorade and Ramen served”.
Cut the cord of mortality and float forever, Turn off your brain, relax, and ride the beam.
